STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER = "yilport"

DELTA_MOVES_PATH = "silver/moves"
LOAD_OUTPUT_PATH = "gold/rehandles_report_yct"
HK_OUTPUT_PATH = "gold/housekeeping_report_yct"

LOAD_TABLE = "rehandles_db.rehandle_details_yct"
HK_TABLE = "rehandles_db.housekeeping_details_yct"

# Shifted unit must be strictly before the load and at most 2h before it
THRESHOLD_SECONDS = 7200

LOAD_EVENT = "UNIT_LOAD"
# Both can be rehandles. Any yard move not matched to a load is non-rehandle.
YARD_EVENTS = ["UNIT_YARD_SHIFT", "UNIT_YARD_MOVE"]

# Exact column names in silver/moves
TO_POSITION_COL = "To_Position_Name"
MOVE_KIND_COL = "Move_kind"

# Classification of non-rehandle yard moves
WITHIN_SECTION_CLASS = "YardShifts"      # from-section == to-section
ACROSS_SECTION_CLASS = "HouseKeeping"    # section to another section, or unparsed

BASE_PATH = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net"
MOVES_PATH = f"{BASE_PATH}/{DELTA_MOVES_PATH}"
LOAD_OUTPUT_DELTA = f"{BASE_PATH}/{LOAD_OUTPUT_PATH}"
HK_OUTPUT_DELTA = f"{BASE_PATH}/{HK_OUTPUT_PATH}"

assert THRESHOLD_SECONDS >= 0
print("Moves source :", MOVES_PATH)
print("Load output  :", LOAD_OUTPUT_DELTA, "->", LOAD_TABLE)
print("HK output    :", HK_OUTPUT_DELTA, "->", HK_TABLE)

from datetime import datetime
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import Window

# Block = 1-2 letters, body = 3-5 digits, last digit = tier (stack height)
# Y-YCT-E13914  -> block E,  body 1391,  tier 4 -> stack E-1391
# Y-YCT-C11914  -> block C,  body 1191,  tier 4 -> stack C-1191
# Y-YCT-S210142 -> block S,  body 21014, tier 2 -> stack S-21014
# Y-YCT-SC02151 -> block SC, body 0215,  tier 1 -> stack SC-0215
# Y-YCT-LC0251  -> block LC, body 025,   tier 1 -> stack LC-025
# No match (NULL): Y-YCT-E5Y, Y-YCT, Y-YCT-CFS
YCT_PATTERN = r"^Y-YCT-([A-Z]{1,2})([0-9]{3,5})([0-9])$"


def with_yct_position(df, src_col, prefix):
    """
    Adds {prefix}_block, {prefix}_section, {prefix}_stack_body,
    {prefix}_tier (int) and {prefix}_stack. Unmatched positions -> NULL.
    Section = block letters.
    """
    tmp = f"_pos_{prefix}"
    df = df.withColumn(tmp, F.upper(F.trim(F.col(src_col))))
    matched = F.col(tmp).rlike(YCT_PATTERN)

    df = (
        df
        .withColumn(f"{prefix}_block",
                    F.when(matched, F.regexp_extract(tmp, YCT_PATTERN, 1)))
        .withColumn(f"{prefix}_section",
            F.when(matched,
                   F.substring(F.regexp_replace(F.col(tmp), r"^Y-YCT-", ""), 1, 4)))
        .withColumn(f"{prefix}_stack_body",
                    F.when(matched, F.regexp_extract(tmp, YCT_PATTERN, 2)))
        .withColumn(f"{prefix}_tier",
                    F.when(matched,
                           F.regexp_extract(tmp, YCT_PATTERN, 3).cast("int")))
        .withColumn(f"{prefix}_stack",
                    F.when(matched,
                           F.concat_ws("-", F.col(f"{prefix}_block"),
                                       F.col(f"{prefix}_stack_body"))))
    )
    return df.drop(tmp)


def with_yct_from_position(df):
    return with_yct_position(df, "From_Position_Name", "from")


def with_yct_to_position(df):
    return with_yct_position(df, TO_POSITION_COL, "to")


def with_move_class(df):
    """YardShifts if both sections parse and are equal, else HouseKeeping."""
    return df.withColumn(
        "move_class",
        F.when(F.col("from_section").isNotNull()
               & F.col("to_section").isNotNull()
               & (F.col("from_section") == F.col("to_section")),
               F.lit(WITHIN_SECTION_CLASS))
         .otherwise(F.lit(ACROSS_SECTION_CLASS)))

# --- Parser test (from position) ---
expected = {
    "Y-YCT-E13914": ("E-1391", 4),
    "Y-YCT-C11914": ("C-1191", 4),
    "Y-YCT-S210142": ("S-21014", 2),
    "Y-YCT-SC02151": ("SC-0215", 1),
    "Y-YCT-LC0251": ("LC-025", 1),
    "Y-YCT-LC025": (None, None),      # too few digits
    "Y-YCT-S2101423": (None, None),   # too many digits
    "Y-YCT-SCC02151": (None, None),   # 3-letter block
    "Y-YCT-E5Y": (None, None),
    "Y-YCT": (None, None),
    "Y-YCT-CFS": (None, None),
}

t = spark.createDataFrame([(p,) for p in expected], ["From_Position_Name"])
parsed = with_yct_from_position(t)

actual = {r["From_Position_Name"]: (r["from_stack"], r["from_tier"])
          for r in parsed.collect()}
assert actual == expected, f"Parser test failed: {actual}"
parsed.show(truncate=False)
print("YCT parser tests passed.")

# --- Classification test (from / to position) ---
# Test data uses the same column name the notebook reads for the To position.
cls_rows = [
    ("Y-YCT-E13914", "Y-YCT-E13024", "HouseKeeping"),    # E139 -> E130
    ("Y-YCT-E13914", "Y-YCT-E13924", "YardShifts"),      # E139 -> E139
    ("Y-YCT-E13914", "Y-YCT-E13814", "HouseKeeping"),    # E139 -> E138
    ("Y-YCT-E13914", "Y-YCT-C11914", "HouseKeeping"),    # E139 -> C119
    ("Y-YCT-SC02151", "Y-YCT-SC02251", "YardShifts"),    # SC02 -> SC02
    ("Y-YCT-SC02151", "Y-YCT-SC03151", "HouseKeeping"),  # SC02 -> SC03
    ("Y-YCT-E13914", "Y-YCT-CFS", "HouseKeeping"),       # unparsed to
    ("Y-YCT-CFS", "Y-YCT-E13914", "HouseKeeping"),       # unparsed from
]
ct = spark.createDataFrame(
    [(f, t_) for f, t_, _ in cls_rows], ["From_Position_Name", TO_POSITION_COL])
ct = with_move_class(with_yct_to_position(with_yct_from_position(ct)))
got = [(r["From_Position_Name"], r[TO_POSITION_COL], r["move_class"])
       for r in ct.collect()]
assert sorted(got) == sorted(cls_rows), f"Class test failed: {got}"
print("Move class tests passed.")

df_all = spark.read.format("delta").load(MOVES_PATH)

# Fail early if a required column is missing (Spark is case-insensitive)
required = ["Event_Type_Id", "t_put", "mve_gkey", "Unit_Nbr",
            "Carrier_Visit_Key", "From_Position_Name", TO_POSITION_COL,
            MOVE_KIND_COL, "Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg", "Freight_Kind_Id",
            "Category_Id", "pow"]
have = {c.lower() for c in df_all.columns}
missing = [c for c in required if c.lower() not in have]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in {MOVES_PATH}: {missing}")

df_all = df_all.withColumn(
    "event_type", F.upper(F.trim(F.col("Event_Type_Id"))))

# One scan: profile by event type, also used as the independent source count
profile = (
    df_all.groupBy("event_type")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("rows"),
         F.sum(F.when(F.col("t_put").isNotNull(), 1).otherwise(0))
          .alias("rows_with_t_put"))
    .orderBy(F.desc("rows"))
)
print("Event types in source (confirm the yard event types):")
profile.show(50, truncate=False)

src_counts = {r["event_type"]: r["rows_with_t_put"] for r in profile.collect()}
src_loads = src_counts.get(LOAD_EVENT, 0)
src_yard = sum(src_counts.get(e, 0) for e in YARD_EVENTS)
print("Source loads (t_put not null):", src_loads)
print("Source yard moves (t_put not null):", src_yard)

RELEVANT_EVENTS = [LOAD_EVENT] + YARD_EVENTS

df_moves = (
    df_all
    .filter(F.col("t_put").isNotNull()
            & F.col("event_type").isin(RELEVANT_EVENTS))
)
df_moves = with_yct_from_position(df_moves)
df_moves = with_yct_to_position(df_moves)
df_moves = df_moves.cache()

print("Relevant moves:", df_moves.count())
df_moves.select("mve_gkey", "Unit_Nbr", "event_type", MOVE_KIND_COL,
                "From_Position_Name", "from_stack", "from_tier",
                TO_POSITION_COL, "to_stack", "t_put").show(10, truncate=False)

loads = (
    df_moves.filter(F.col("event_type") == LOAD_EVENT)
    .select(
        F.col("mve_gkey").alias("mve_gkey_load"),
        F.col("Unit_Nbr").alias("load_unit_nbr"),
        F.col("Carrier_Visit_Key").alias("carrier_visit_key"),
        F.col("From_Position_Name").alias("load_from_position"),
        F.col("from_stack").alias("load_from_stack"),
        F.col("from_tier").alias("load_tier"),
        F.col("t_put").alias("load_time"),
        F.to_date(F.col("t_put")).alias("load_date"),
        F.col("Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg").cast("double").alias("load_weight_kg"),
        F.col("Freight_Kind_Id").alias("load_freight_kind"),
        F.col("Category_Id").alias("load_category_id"),
        F.col("pow").alias("load_pow"),
    )
)

# Full-width yard moves (kept whole for the non-rehandle table)
yard_moves = df_moves.filter(F.col("event_type").isin(YARD_EVENTS))

# Slim version used for matching, carrying the shifted-unit details
yard_keys = yard_moves.select(
    F.col("mve_gkey").alias("mve_gkey_shift"),
    F.col("Unit_Nbr").alias("shift_unit_nbr"),
    F.col("event_type").alias("shift_event_type"),
    F.col(MOVE_KIND_COL).alias("shift_move_kind"),
    F.col("From_Position_Name").alias("shift_from_position"),
    F.col(TO_POSITION_COL).alias("shift_to_position"),
    F.col("from_stack").alias("shift_from_stack"),
    F.col("from_tier").alias("shift_tier"),
    F.col("t_put").alias("shift_time"),
)


def fail_if_invalid_keys(df, key_column, label):
    if df.filter(F.col(key_column).isNull()).limit(1).count():
        raise ValueError(f"{label} contains a null {key_column}")
    dup = df.groupBy(key_column).count().filter("count > 1").limit(1)
    if dup.count():
        raise ValueError(f"{label} contains duplicate {key_column}")


fail_if_invalid_keys(loads, "mve_gkey_load", "Loads")
fail_if_invalid_keys(yard_keys, "mve_gkey_shift", "Yard moves")

print("Loads      :", loads.count())
print("Yard moves :", yard_keys.count())

# Population check for the two detail columns, by event type
def _blank(c):
    return F.sum(F.when(F.col(c).isNull() | (F.trim(F.col(c)) == ""), 1)
                  .otherwise(0))

print("Blank counts for yard moves, by event type:")
(yard_moves.groupBy("event_type")
 .agg(F.count("*").alias("rows"),
      _blank("From_Position_Name").alias("from_blank"),
      _blank(TO_POSITION_COL).alias("to_blank"),
      _blank(MOVE_KIND_COL).alias("kind_blank"))
 .show(truncate=False))

def assign_rehandles(loads_df, yard_df):
    """
    A yard move is a rehandle for a load when:
      - same stack
      - the moved unit was higher in the stack (shift_tier > load_tier)
      - it is a different unit from the load
      - shift_time < load_time <= shift_time + THRESHOLD_SECONDS
    Each yard move is credited to its first qualifying later load.
    """
    l = (loads_df
         .select("mve_gkey_load", "load_unit_nbr", "load_from_stack",
                 "load_tier", "load_time")
         .filter(F.col("load_from_stack").isNotNull()
                 & F.col("load_tier").isNotNull())
         .alias("l"))

    s = (yard_df
         .filter(F.col("shift_from_stack").isNotNull()
                 & F.col("shift_tier").isNotNull())
         .alias("s"))

    cond = (
        (F.col("s.shift_from_stack") == F.col("l.load_from_stack"))
        & (F.col("s.shift_tier") > F.col("l.load_tier"))
        & (F.col("s.shift_unit_nbr") != F.col("l.load_unit_nbr"))
        & (F.col("s.shift_time") < F.col("l.load_time"))
        & (F.col("l.load_time")
           <= F.col("s.shift_time")
              + F.expr(f"INTERVAL {THRESHOLD_SECONDS} SECONDS"))
    )

    candidates = s.join(l, cond, "inner").select(
        "s.mve_gkey_shift", "s.shift_unit_nbr", "s.shift_event_type",
        "s.shift_move_kind", "s.shift_from_position",
        "s.shift_to_position", "s.shift_tier", "s.shift_time",
        "l.mve_gkey_load", "l.load_time",
    )

    w = Window.partitionBy("mve_gkey_shift").orderBy(
        F.col("load_time").asc(), F.col("mve_gkey_load").asc())

    assigned = (candidates
                .withColumn("_rk", F.row_number().over(w))
                .filter(F.col("_rk") == 1).drop("_rk"))

    # The struct starts with shift_time, so sort_array orders by time
    # (then by key). All the detail arrays share that order.
    per_load = (
        assigned.groupBy("mve_gkey_load")
        .agg(
            F.count("*").alias("rehandle_count"),
            F.sort_array(F.collect_set("mve_gkey_shift"))
                .alias("rehandle_shift_ids"),
            F.sort_array(F.collect_set("shift_unit_nbr"))
                .alias("rehandle_unit_nbrs"),
            F.min("shift_time").alias("first_rehandle_time"),
            F.max("shift_time").alias("last_rehandle_time"),
            F.sort_array(F.collect_list(F.struct(
                F.col("shift_time"),
                F.col("mve_gkey_shift"),
                F.col("shift_unit_nbr").alias("unit_nbr"),
                F.col("shift_event_type").alias("event_type_id"),
                F.col("shift_move_kind").alias("move_kind"),
                F.col("shift_from_position").alias("from_position"),
                F.col("shift_to_position").alias("to_position"),
                F.col("shift_tier").alias("from_tier"),
            ))).alias("rehandle_details"),
        )
        # Flat arrays, aligned with rehandle_details (same order)
        .withColumn("rehandle_event_types",
                    F.expr("transform(rehandle_details, x -> x.event_type_id)"))
        .withColumn("rehandle_move_kinds",
                    F.expr("transform(rehandle_details, x -> x.move_kind)"))
        .withColumn("rehandle_from_positions",
                    F.expr("transform(rehandle_details, x -> x.from_position)"))
        .withColumn("rehandle_to_positions",
                    F.expr("transform(rehandle_details, x -> x.to_position)"))
    )
    return per_load, assigned

# ---------- Test ----------
tl = spark.createDataFrame(
    [(101, "U1", "E-1391", 2, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 10)),
     (102, "U2", "E-1391", 1, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 40)),
     (103, "U3", "C-1191", 1, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 10))],
    "mve_gkey_load long, load_unit_nbr string, load_from_stack string, "
    "load_tier int, load_time timestamp")

ts = spark.createDataFrame(
    [(201, "A", "UNIT_YARD_SHIFT", "K1", "P1", "T201", "E-1391", 4, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 9, 50)),   # -> 101
     (202, "B", "UNIT_YARD_MOVE",  "K2", "P1", "T202", "E-1391", 3, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 5)),   # -> 101
     (203, "C", "UNIT_YARD_SHIFT", "K3", "P1", "T203", "E-1391", 2, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 30)),  # -> 102
     (204, "D", "UNIT_YARD_SHIFT", "K4", "P1", "T204", "E-1391", 1, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 5)),   # below both: no
     (205, "E", "UNIT_YARD_SHIFT", "K5", "P1", "T205", "E-1391", 2, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0)),   # not > 2 for 101; > 1 for 102 -> 102
     (206, "F", "UNIT_YARD_SHIFT", "K6", "P1", "T206", "E-1391", 5, datetime(2026, 1, 1, 7, 0))],   # >2h before: no
    "mve_gkey_shift long, shift_unit_nbr string, shift_event_type string, "
    "shift_move_kind string, shift_from_position string, "
    "shift_to_position string, shift_from_stack string, "
    "shift_tier int, shift_time timestamp")

tpl, _ = assign_rehandles(tl, ts)
res = {r["mve_gkey_load"]: r["rehandle_count"]
       for r in tl.join(tpl, "mve_gkey_load", "left")
       .select("mve_gkey_load",
               F.coalesce("rehandle_count", F.lit(0)).alias("rehandle_count"))
       .collect()}
assert res == {101: 2, 102: 2, 103: 0}, f"Matching test failed: {res}"
print("Matching test passed:", res)

# Detail arrays line up with the shifted units (time order)
d = tpl.filter("mve_gkey_load = 101").first()
assert d["rehandle_event_types"] == ["UNIT_YARD_SHIFT", "UNIT_YARD_MOVE"], d["rehandle_event_types"]
assert d["rehandle_move_kinds"] == ["K1", "K2"], d["rehandle_move_kinds"]
assert d["rehandle_to_positions"] == ["T201", "T202"], d["rehandle_to_positions"]
print("Detail array test passed.")

# ---------- Production ----------
per_load, assigned_shifts = assign_rehandles(loads, yard_keys)
assigned_shifts = assigned_shifts.cache()   # reused by results, housekeeping, counts

# One row per load, rehandle details attached
df_results = (
    loads.join(per_load, "mve_gkey_load", "left")
    .withColumn("rehandle_count",
                F.coalesce(F.col("rehandle_count"), F.lit(0).cast("long")))
    .withColumn("has_rehandle", F.col("rehandle_count") > 0)
    .cache()
)

# Non-rehandle yard moves = all yard moves minus the assigned shifts,
# split into YardShifts (within section) and HouseKeeping (across sections)
df_housekeeping = (
    yard_moves
    .join(assigned_shifts.select(F.col("mve_gkey_shift").alias("mve_gkey")),
          "mve_gkey", "left_anti")
    .withColumn("move_date", F.to_date(F.col("t_put")))
    .withColumn(
        "housekeeping_reason",
        F.when(F.col("from_stack").isNull(), "UNPARSED_POSITION")
         .otherwise("NOT_MATCHED_TO_LOAD"))
)
df_housekeeping = with_move_class(df_housekeeping).cache()

total_loads = loads.count()
total_yard = yard_keys.count()
assigned_count = assigned_shifts.count()
hk_count = df_housekeeping.count()
output_count = df_results.count()

total_rehandles = df_results.agg(F.sum("rehandle_count")).first()[0] or 0

class_counts = {r["move_class"]: r["count"]
                for r in df_housekeeping.groupBy("move_class").count().collect()}

assert output_count == total_loads, "Load table is not one row per load"
assert total_rehandles == assigned_count, \
    "Sum of rehandle_count differs from assigned shifts"
assert assigned_count + hk_count == total_yard, \
    f"{assigned_count} + {hk_count} != {total_yard} yard moves"
assert sum(class_counts.values()) == hk_count, \
    "move_class counts do not add up to the non-rehandle table"

print("Total loads            :", total_loads)
print("Total yard moves       :", total_yard)
print("Rehandles (assigned)   :", assigned_count)
print("Non-rehandle moves     :", hk_count, class_counts)
print("Loads with rehandles   :", df_results.filter("has_rehandle").count())
print("Unparsed load positions:",
      loads.filter(F.col("load_from_stack").isNull()).count())

print("\nNon-rehandle yard moves by class / reason / event type:")
(df_housekeeping.groupBy("move_class", "housekeeping_reason", "event_type")
 .count().orderBy("move_class", "housekeeping_reason", "event_type")
 .show(truncate=False))

print("Top unparsed FROM positions (all moves):")
(df_moves.filter(F.col("from_stack").isNull())
 .groupBy("From_Position_Name").count()
 .orderBy(F.desc("count")).show(20, truncate=False))

print("Top unparsed TO positions (yard moves):")
(yard_moves.filter(F.col("to_stack").isNull())
 .groupBy(TO_POSITION_COL).count()
 .orderBy(F.desc("count")).show(20, truncate=False))

# src_loads / src_yard come from the source profile in Cell 4,
# not from the split logic, so this is an independent check.
rehandles = total_rehandles

# Test 1: loads
assert src_loads == output_count, \
    f"Loads: source {src_loads} vs table {output_count}"

# Test 2: yard moves = rehandles + non-rehandle rows
assert src_yard == rehandles + hk_count, \
    f"Yard moves: source {src_yard} vs {rehandles} + {hk_count}"

# Test 3: combined
assert (src_loads + src_yard) == (output_count + rehandles + hk_count), \
    "Combined total mismatch"

# Test 4: no yard move is both a rehandle and a non-rehandle row
rehandled_ids = (
    df_results.filter("rehandle_count > 0")
    .select(F.explode("rehandle_shift_ids").alias("mve_gkey"))
)
overlap = rehandled_ids.join(df_housekeeping.select("mve_gkey"), "mve_gkey").count()
assert overlap == 0, f"{overlap} yard moves appear as rehandle AND housekeeping"

print(f"Loads {src_loads} = {output_count}")
print(f"Yard moves {src_yard} = rehandles {rehandles} + non-rehandle {hk_count}")
print(f"Combined {src_loads + src_yard} = {output_count + rehandles + hk_count}")

spark.sql("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS rehandles_db")


def check_table_location(table, target):
    if spark.catalog.tableExists(table):
        loc = (spark.sql(f"DESCRIBE DETAIL {table}")
               .select("location").first()["location"])
        if loc.rstrip("/") != target.rstrip("/"):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{table} already points to {loc}, not {target}.")


def write_table(df, table, target):
    (df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite")
       .option("overwriteSchema", "true").save(target))
    spark.sql(f"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {table} "
              f"USING DELTA LOCATION '{target}'")
    print("Written:", target, "->", table)


# Check both locations BEFORE overwriting anything
check_table_location(LOAD_TABLE, LOAD_OUTPUT_DELTA)
check_table_location(HK_TABLE, HK_OUTPUT_DELTA)

write_table(df_results, LOAD_TABLE, LOAD_OUTPUT_DELTA)
write_table(df_housekeeping, HK_TABLE, HK_OUTPUT_DELTA)

chk_l = spark.read.format("delta").load(LOAD_OUTPUT_DELTA)
chk_h = spark.read.format("delta").load(HK_OUTPUT_DELTA)

saved_l = chk_l.count()
saved_h = chk_h.count()
saved_rehandles = chk_l.agg(F.sum("rehandle_count")).first()[0] or 0

assert saved_l == total_loads
assert saved_rehandles == total_rehandles
assert saved_h == hk_count
assert (src_loads + src_yard) == (saved_l + saved_rehandles + saved_h), \
    "Saved tables do not reconcile to the source"

print("Saved tables reconcile to source:",
      src_loads + src_yard, "=", saved_l, "+", saved_rehandles, "+", saved_h)
print("Load table rows   :", saved_l)
print("Housekeeping rows :", saved_h)

chk_l.select("mve_gkey_load", "load_unit_nbr", "load_from_stack",
             "load_tier", "load_time", "rehandle_count", "rehandle_unit_nbrs",
             "rehandle_event_types", "rehandle_move_kinds",
             "rehandle_to_positions", "has_rehandle") \
    .orderBy(F.desc("rehandle_count"), F.asc("load_time")) \
    .show(20, truncate=False)
